_comment: Shown to models by scripts/evaluate.py. Notes document the legacy quirks the way a team's data dictionary would, without hinting at any trap. example_rows: per table, WHERE conditions whose first matching row (by id) must be among the example rows; the rest are the first rows by id.
notes: adres: rows migrated from the old system (kaynak_sistem = 'ESKI_AKTARIM') store sehir, ilce, mahalle and sokak in upper case; the other rows use normal capitalization.
okuma.okuma_tarihi is text in DD.MM.YYYY format; the other date columns hold ISO dates.
odeme.odenen_tutar is text in Turkish number format.
